title: Igrot Kodesh - Letter No. 223
response_propositions: The letter distinguishes an unpaid publishing debt from a merely private financial matter because nonpayment prevents additional chassidic works from being printed.
It asks the recipient not only to discharge the debt but also to increase support for publication within the authority granted by the Previous Rebbe.
When the recipient says ordinary capacity has been exhausted, the response calls for mobilizing deeper reserves of effort rather than accepting the impasse.
